headlines.title: Two violating oil tankers explode on unauthorized route in Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy Public Relations announced that two violating oil tankers exploded on the unauthorized route of the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Fourth violating oil tanker explodes after hitting mine east of Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – A fourth oil tanker violating designated maritime routes in the Strait of Hormuz exploded and caught fire after striking a naval mine early on Tuesday, the IRGC Navy announced.

headlines.title: Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until Iran’s conditions are met: Army chief
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA — Chief Commander of the Islamic Republic of Iran, Army Major General Amir Hatami, has reiterated Iran’s resolve to safeguard national interests, saying the acceptance of seven conditions put forward to the United States is the only way to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Iran elected to executive board of UNEP’s Global Framework on Chemicals Fund
headlines.snippet: London, IRNA – Iran has been elected to the Executive Board of the Special Program Trust Fund of the Global Framework on Chemicals (GFC) under the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) for a three-year term, representing the Asia-Pacific regional group.

headlines.title: Iran tightens security measures in Strait of Hormuz: Army
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia says the military had stepped up surveillance and control of the Strait of Hormuz, warning that vessels must coordinate their passage with the Iranian Armed Forces to ensure safe transit.

headlines.title: Iran resolved to break US-imposed blockade
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 24 (MNA) – Major General Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, says that the Iranian nation and its armed forces are resolved to break the blockade imposed by Washington.

headlines.title: Iran destroys US Lucas, MQ-9 drones over southern waters
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – Iran's Army air defense forces destroyed two U.S. drones, a Lucas and an MQ-9, over the western and eastern Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Relocation of US bases will not make them secure
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 24 (MNA) – Major General Abdollahi, Chief of Staff of Iran’s Armed Forces, says relocating US bases in the region would not change Iran’s resolve to counter threats, stressing that Iran can hit the US bases whereever they be.

headlines.title: Iran UN envoy warns on military use of AI
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – Iran's ambassador to the UN warned that the weaponization of artificial intelligence and its use in aggression raise serious concerns, citing reports that the U.S. used advanced AI systems in the 2026 war on Iran.

headlines.title: 1 Flogging of Iranian singer Parastoo Ahmadi sparks outrage on social media
headlines.snippet: The flogging of Iranian singer Parastoo Ahmadi and four members of her concert team on Monday sparked outrage on social media, with artists, activists and other users condemning the punishment and denouncing restrictions on women’s artistic expression in Iran.

headlines.title: 2 Iran’s rial falls past 2.85 million to the dollar
headlines.snippet: The US dollar broke through 2.85 million rials on Iran’s open market on Tuesday, deepening a currency crisis driven by soaring inflation, a US naval blockade that has choked oil exports and mounting US financial pressure.

headlines.title: 3 ANALYSIS Tehran claims its missiles can reach Europe. What has it shown?
headlines.snippet: An Iranian lawmaker’s claim that Tehran’s missiles can now travel 4,500 kilometers and a front-page boast by Tehran daily Hamshahri that all of Europe is within reach have renewed questions about Iran’s ability to strike the continent.

headlines.title: 4 Iranian media walk back tanker convoy claims after days of blockade-breaking hype
headlines.snippet: Iranian state media and officials have denied that Iran was about to send tankers through the US naval blockade, after four days in which Guards-linked outlets, lawmakers and Friday prayer leaders spread the claim and AI-generated images showed ships breaking through.

headlines.title: 5 ANALYSIS Iran’s disillusionment with Russia and China grows across political camps
headlines.snippet: A sense of strategic disappointment has emerged across Iran’s political spectrum over the limits of Russian and Chinese support during the 2026 war and the US naval blockade that followed.
